name: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)

ministry.name: Ministry of Education
ministry.department: Department of School Education and Literacy

overview: A centrally sponsored scheme providing free hot cooked mid-day meals to children studying in government and government-aided schools to improve nutritional levels and school attendance.
objectives: Improve nutritional status of children in classes I-VIII
Encourage enrolment, retention and attendance in schools
Address hunger and malnutrition among school-age children

benefits.title: Free Hot Cooked Meal
benefits.description: Daily nutritious meal provided on all school working days

benefits.title: Nutritional Support
benefits.description: Meals designed to meet prescribed calorie and protein norms

otherCriteria: Must be enrolled in a government or government-aided school

applicationProcess.description: Enrol in a government or government-aided school
Meal is provided automatically to enrolled students on school days

faqs.question: Who is eligible for PM POSHAN?
faqs.answer: Children studying in classes I to VIII in government and government-aided schools.

faqs.question: Is there any cost to students?
faqs.answer: No, the meal is provided free of cost.

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan

ministry.name: Ministry of Education
ministry.department: Department of School Education and Literacy

overview: An integrated scheme for school education covering pre-school to class 12, subsuming Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan and Teacher Education, aimed at improving school effectiveness and equitable learning outcomes.
objectives: Universal access to quality school education
Bridge gender and social category gaps in education
Ensure inclusive education for children with special needs

benefits.title: Infrastructure Support
benefits.description: Grants for classrooms, ICT labs, smart classrooms and school infrastructure

benefits.title: Inclusive Education
benefits.description: Support for children with disabilities and special needs

otherCriteria: Applicable to government and government-aided schools from pre-school to class 12

applicationProcess.description: Scheme implemented through State Implementation Societies
Schools and students benefit through respective state education departments

faqs.question: What does Samagra Shiksha cover?
faqs.answer: It covers the entire school education spectrum from pre-school to class 12.

faqs.question: Which schemes were merged into it?
faqs.answer: Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan and Teacher Education.

name: PM SHRI Schools (PM Schools for Rising India)

ministry.name: Ministry of Education
ministry.department: Department of School Education and Literacy

overview: A centrally sponsored scheme to develop existing schools across India into PM SHRI Schools that showcase the implementation of the National Education Policy 2020 with modern infrastructure and holistic development.
objectives: Provide quality education with modern infrastructure
Promote holistic, experiential and joyful learning

benefits.title: Upgraded Infrastructure
benefits.description: Modern labs, libraries, smart classrooms and sports facilities

benefits.title: Quality Curriculum
benefits.description: NEP 2020 aligned holistic and skill-based education

otherCriteria: Selected government schools from States/UTs, KVS and NVS through a challenge mode

applicationProcess.description: State/UT nominates schools through challenge mode
Schools selected based on defined criteria under UDISE+
Selected schools receive funding and support for upgradation

faqs.question: What is PM SHRI?
faqs.answer: A scheme to upgrade select existing schools into model schools reflecting NEP 2020.

faqs.question: Who selects the schools?
faqs.answer: Schools are selected via a challenge mode based on UDISE+ data.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)

ministry.name: Ministry of Education
ministry.department: Department of School Education and Literacy

overview: A scholarship scheme to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to reduce the dropout rate at the class VIII to XII level.
objectives: Reduce dropout rate at secondary school stage
Encourage economically weaker meritorious students to continue education

benefits.title: Scholarship Amount
benefits.description: Rs. 12,000 per annum per student from class IX to XII

education: Class VIII pass with minimum 55% marks
otherCriteria: Must be studying in a government, government-aided or local body school

applicationProcess.description: Qualify the state-level NMMS selection examination
Apply through the National Scholarship Portal

faqs.question: Who conducts the selection exam?
faqs.answer: State/UT governments conduct the NMMS examination.

faqs.question: What is the scholarship amount?
faqs.answer: Rs. 12,000 per annum, disbursed via DBT.

name: Rashtriya Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan (RUSA)
overview: A centrally sponsored scheme aimed at providing strategic funding to state higher educational institutions to improve access, equity and quality in higher education.
objectives: Improve access, equity and quality in state higher education
Support creation of new institutions and upgradation of existing ones
Ensure adequate faculty and improve governance

benefits.title: Institutional Funding
benefits.description: Grants to state universities and colleges for infrastructure and quality improvement

benefits.title: Faculty Development
benefits.description: Support for filling faculty positions and capacity building

otherCriteria: Applicable to state government higher education institutions

applicationProcess.description: State Higher Education Council submits perspective plan
Proposals appraised by RUSA project appraisal board

faqs.question: Who can benefit from RUSA?
faqs.answer: State public higher education institutions such as universities and colleges.

faqs.question: Which ministry runs RUSA?
faqs.answer: Ministry of Education, Department of Higher Education.
